# Phase 9 core functional supervised local tools

You are the Biel4 Executor. Work only on the already-created local branch feat/phase-9-supervised-tools at starting SHA 06414e05765fe96f3e6fd736775c70e21187d5bb. Read E:\AIP\AGENTS.md and the required AIP implementation, phase, security, and publication skills before editing. Read docs/PHASE_9_TOOLS_SPEC.md, docs/CORRECTIVE_GAP_MATRIX.md, apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/tools.rs, apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/database.rs, apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/lib.rs, and the existing tool tests first.

Implement the core functional Phase 9 local workspace capability, preserving existing explicit fixture-only mock tools. Add at least two real supervised local actions: (1) a bounded read-only directory/scope inspection under an Owner-configured workspace root; (2) a state-changing organize/move action that only moves/renames files within that configured root and can be previewed, dry-run, explicitly approved, second-confirmed for higher risk, executed, cancelled, and safely compensated/rolled back. Keep calendar/messaging provider-neutral mocks unless already present; do not add external network integration or credentials.

Required safety and authority behavior:
- Add a SQLite migration (next version, 0023) for owner-scoped configured workspace roots and any durable operation metadata needed by the existing tool audit/idempotency model. Keep Rust/SQLite authoritative and preserve agent/Owner isolation.
- Add explicit local manifests/adapter kind and scope syntax (for example workspace_root:<opaque-root-id>) while retaining all fixture manifests and making the distinction visible. Root configuration must be Owner-scoped, use durable opaque IDs, and support list/remove/disabled state without exposing private paths in audit payloads.
- Canonicalize and validate roots and every source/destination immediately before use. Reject traversal, drive roots/broad/system directories, missing roots, symlink/junction/reparse-point escapes, paths outside the canonical root, source/destination symlinks or reparse points, existing destinations, and cross-root operations. On Windows reject FILE_ATTRIBUTE_REPARSE_POINT (0x400) and system/broad roots; use portable safe behavior/tests on non-Windows. Never follow links.
- Inspect only bounded names/metadata/counts; do not persist or return unbounded file contents. Organize only deterministic relative paths with bounded counts/lengths and no deletion/system-file behavior. Use std::fs::rename only after final validation; preserve an exact bounded preview and approval/confirmation binding so execution cannot silently change the approved operation.
- Add an Executed/changed result status while preserving DryRun/Simulated/Cancelled/Compensated fixture semantics. Return explicit degraded/denied errors when root/device/path conditions fail; never claim simulated success for real effects. Cancellation and compensation must verify owner/agent/operation ownership and only reverse moves whose recorded source/destination still match safe canonical paths.
- Keep safe-mode, temporary-chat, Owner/silent/suspended gates and existing replay/idempotency/audit controls fail-closed. Do not add arbitrary shell, network/upload, telemetry, background watchers, hidden listeners, broad filesystem scans, or raw private path values to logs/docs.

Tests are mandatory and deterministic: migration/fixture coverage; root ownership/isolation; traversal/system-root rejection; symlink/junction/reparse rejection where supported; bounded inspection; preview/approval/second-confirmation/dry-run; real temporary-directory move execution with changed=true; cancellation and safe compensation rollback; replay/idempotency and denied safe-mode/temporary-chat paths. Do not hardcode user-private paths.

Validation before commit: cargo fmt --check; cargo check --locked; cargo clippy --locked --all-targets -- -D warnings; cargo test --locked --lib; run focused existing tool tests; pnpm --filter @aip/contracts typecheck if contracts are affected; pnpm --filter @aip/desktop typecheck if desktop is affected; pnpm secrets:scan; git diff --check. Report every command, pass/fail, files changed, remaining human-only checks, and final SHA. Commit only this core Phase 9 scope with exact message `feat: implement phase 9 supervised local tools`. Do not push, create PR, merge, tag, release, modify unrelated files, or implement Phase 10+.

If a requirement would weaken an existing gate or requires unprovided OS/provider credentials, stop with a precise blocker rather than faking success.
constraints: Use only the configured Biel4 App Server Executor; no native subagents and no alternate backend.
Local edits and one scoped local commit are authorized; no remote GitHub mutation, push, PR, merge, tag, release, or deployment.
No arbitrary shell, network/upload, telemetry, background watcher, public listener, raw-content persistence, broad filesystem access, or safety weakening.
Preserve fixture tools explicitly and keep real local effects owner-scoped, bounded, reversible where safe, and truthfully statused.
Do not implement Phase 10 or later functionality in this request.
